title: Set up the Watchlist project
prompt: You're on a fresh laptop with Node.js installed. Put these steps in the order you'd run them to get the Watchlist project running and showing your own heading in the browser.
hints: You can't install dependencies for a project that doesn't exist yet.
npm commands run against the package.json in the current folder, so you need to be inside the project first.
explanation: First confirm Node is new enough for Vite (20.19+ or 22.12+). Scaffolding creates the `watchlist` folder, so you `cd` into it before `npm install`, which reads its `package.json`. `npm run dev` starts the server on port 5173. Only then does editing `App.jsx` show up in the browser, via hot module replacement.

items.edit-app:
Replace src/App.jsx with your own `

My Watchlist

` and save
